movies.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology.
When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot is tasked to pilot a spacecraft.
Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora.
A cafe owner becomes a local hero, but events unravel bringing figures from his past.
